## MAPMsG - Python Port

This is a derivative work ported from MATLAB to Python. The original MATLAB
implementation is by O. Gursoy, K. A. Mehr, and N. Akar.

### Reference

O. Gursoy, K. A. Mehr, and N. Akar, "The MAP/M/s + G Call Center Model with
Generally Distributed Patience Times: Steady-state Solution and First Passage
Time Distribution."
